messages:
mira: Hey sec team — need a short (1h) console sudo to rotate a customer API key in prod that's failing validation in the connector. Root cause looks like an old key still referenced in a third-party integration. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood-inference/ops/key-rotation-prod. Ticket: #INC-4821. Proposed window today 14:30-15:30 UTC. Blocking customer onboarding. Will capture commands and paste outputs to the ticket. @alex (sec) @jordan-oncall

sec-bot: Automated check — please specify exact scope (which secrets/resources), justification, and the exact commands you will run. If PII is involved tag accordingly. Link to ticket needed. Requestor must re-auth (MFA) before elevation is granted.

alex (sec): hi mira — can you confirm which secret/service-account? 'integration-service-prod' or 'thirdparty-connector'? does this require DB access or is it limited to secret rotate + deploy?

mira: Scope: secretsmanager secret 'prod/customer-api-keys' and service-account 'svc/integration-prod' for a deploy restart only. No DB access. Exact commands: 
```bash
./tools/key_rotate.sh --secret prod/customer-api-keys --new-key ${NEW_KEY}
kubectl -n integrations rollout restart deploy/connector
```
I'll paste sanitized logs to the ticket. No PII.

jordan-oncall: I can provision a 1h break-glass window if Alex signs off on scope. Condition: connect via bastion (ssh -J bastion), record session, and paste commands in ticket. I'll set tentative window 14:45-15:45 UTC to allow queueing. @approvals-bot please queue.

approvals-bot: Approval request created: #APP-9863 — Approvers: alex (sec), jordan-oncall. Duration: 60m. One-click grant: https://approvals.internal/APP-9863. Granting creates ephemeral role 'elev-temp-APP-9863' and enables audit logging.

alex (sec): Reviewed commands and scope. Looks limited to secretsmanager + restart; no DB. Approving — please MFA re-auth and use `sudo --preserve-env -u admin -s` on bastion to assume role. Approving APP-9863 now.

approvals-bot: APP-9863 status: approved by alex, jordan-oncall. Granting ephemeral credentials... Done. Elevated role expires at 2026-03-17T15:45:00Z. Audit stream enabled at /audit/elevations/APP-9863.

ops-sre: Quick reminder — if the connector mounts secrets as a kube secret, rotate that too or the connector may keep using the old value. Also consider bumping readiness probe timeout briefly to avoid a restart loop.

mira: Thanks — starting now. Will paste outputs to the ticket and redact keys before posting. Will ping here when finished.

mira: Done — rotated key, restarted connector, verified onboarding endpoint returns 200 and the customer flow progressed. Logs and sanitized command output attached to #INC-4821. Revoking privileges now. Confirmed no DB access was performed. Thanks :raised_hands: 

approvals-bot: APP-9863 status: closed by mira. Elevation window ended. Audit: /audit/elevations/APP-9863/log.json

alex (sec): Thanks for the quick turnaround. Two follow-ups: 1) add a short RCA note in the ticket about how the old key remained referenced (config drift), and 2) I'll open a PR to add a secret-scanner rule to catch the current pattern.

jordan-oncall: :thumbsup:
